theme: Hybrid (Dark Marketing Hero + Light Admin Dashboard)

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Strict 8px grid system inspired by Linear. Generous spacing for marketing, high-density for dashboards.
layout_and_spacing.marketing_grid: Bento 'Tetris' Grid, gap-8 to gap-12. Asymmetrical balance.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Control Room Grid, gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized. h-full for equal heights.

surfaces_and_effects.dashboard_cards: bg-white border border-[#E2E8F0] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200
surfaces_and_effects.glow_effects: Use absolute positioning with blur-3xl and 20-30% opacity behind key elements. (e.g., bg-emerald-500/20 blur-[100px])

components.buttons: Linear-style. 8px padding vertical, 16px horizontal. rounded-lg. Primary uses Royal Blue, subtle hover lift. Include data-testid.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. Height 40px (h-10), rounded-md, 1px border. Focus ring uses Emerald or Royal Blue.
components.tables: Shadcn based. Dense padding (py-2 px-4). Sticky header. 1px bottom borders for rows, no vertical borders. text-sm.
components.navigation: Dark glassmorphic header for marketing (z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050B14]/80 border-b border-white/10). Clean white sidebar for admin dashboard.

motion_and_interaction.hero_animations: Framer Motion. Staggered fade-up (y: 20, opacity: 0). Floating glass cards using yoyo animation (y: [0, -10, 0], duration: 4).
motion_and_interaction.live_counters: Framer Motion animate function for counting up to specific numbers (e.g., Total Rent Collected).
motion_and_interaction.microinteractions: Button hover: slight scale (scale: 0.98 for click). Row hover in tables: bg-slate-50.

icons.style: Minimalist, stroke-width 1.5 or 2 depending on weight context.

images.description: Dark blue/black abstract geometric 3D glass, perfect for the hero background with an overlay.
Modern clear glass building for feature sections to represent the high-end property management aspect.
Professional smiling woman for testimonial or resident profile placeholder.
Professional man in henley top for testimonial or resident profile placeholder.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. HYBRID THEME AESTHETIC: The marketing pages (Hero, Home) must be Dark Theme. The internal Dashboard must be Light Theme. Do not mix them improperly.

2. HERO SECTION: Implement an ultra-premium hero using `framer-motion`. Include 2-3 floating glass cards (e.g., 'Total Beds', 'Rent Collected') with backdrop-blur. Use the dark blue/black abstract geometric image as a subtle background with a heavy dark overlay (bg-[#050B14]/80) so it doesn't distract. Add an Emerald Green radial glow behind the floating cards.

3. DASHBOARD AESTHETIC: Follow the 'Linear/Vercel' look. Use `#FAFBFC` for the main background. Cards should be crisp `#FFFFFF` with a `1px` border of `#E2E8F0` and minimal shadow. Dense data display using an 8px scale.
4. TYPOGRAPHY: Ensure you use `Outfit` for headings and `Manrope` for body text. Apply `tracking-tight` to headings. Include Google Fonts links in the index.html or import them in CSS.

5. SHADCN UI: Use shadcn components extensively for the dashboard (Tables, Dialogs, Select, Dropdowns, DatePicker). Customize their default borders and radii to match the guidelines (border-[#E2E8F0], rounded-md/lg).
6. RENT TRACKER: For the rent tracker widget, implement a 'one-tap mark paid' button inside a dense list or table. Use the Emerald accent color for the 'Paid' state.
7. TESTING: ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, row actions) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-btn"`).
8. AUTOMATION UI: For the n8n-style automation engine, use visually distinct nodes or cards connected to represent WhatsApp challans/reminders.
9. DO NOT USE PLACEHOLDER IMAGES: Rely strictly on the media URLs provided in this document.
